title: Mahalanobis-Based Multi-Head Attention for Complex State Propagation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24462v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we propose \textbf{Mahalanobis-Based Multi-Head Attention} (MHA-CSP), a novel attention mechanism that replaces the standard dot-product with a \textbf{Mahalanobis distance-based RBF kernel}, which effectively computes attention in an infinite-dimensional feature space without increasing the parameter count. Crucially, the positive definiteness of the Mahalanobis distance enables a \textbf{direct construction of Tree Attention}: attention scores are built directly from accumulated distances, with a LogSumExp correction that rectifies the raw distance by subtracting the log-sum of edge exponentials. Moreover, the multi-head Mahalanobis distance matrices are themselves repurposed to construct an \textbf{attention meshing mechanism}, enabling cross-head kernel collaboration that simultaneously boosts accuracy and training efficiency. tldr: 本文提出了一种基于马氏距离RBF核的多头注意力机制，通过正定性直接构建树状注意力并引入注意力网格机制，以极少的参数实现复杂状态传播中的高效建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Mahalanobis-based multi-head attention mechanism that uses a positive-definite RBF kernel to directly construct tree attention and introduces an attention meshing mechanism, achieving efficient modeling of complex state propagation with minimal parameters.
